items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: He worked with Oil Four Shed, him and I. We work a long time.

ctx.x: Yeah, he plays in church. Yeah, he quit. He worked with Oil Four Shed, him and I. We work a long time. I quit Oil Four Shed. We used to work over here at Buckaloo, you know, Oil Four Shed, saxophone player. He'd go to sleep driving, so I made it win one night. I said I wasn't going back. He was sitting at Capitol Hill. Had a wreck. I tore him up. Had a big operation on him. He worked with Eddie
